result:
Round 238 passes, with no bugs found. Both round-237 problems are fixed, and I checked this in real Chromium on `/studio-lab` at 1440×900 and 1280×720: a fresh context per attempt, `auth_user` null, and no page errors. Every browser row that can run in the cloud ran, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true. I changed no app source; `git status` in the repo is the same before and after my work.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| C-SCOPE | HEAD is `ecaf0e4` and the same 11 paths are dirty. The frozen 1,098 files, the root files and the protected auth files are unchanged. Only the 3 granted files changed. The test file has 0 removed lines. `ArrangementContext.tsx` matches B's pre-checked diff byte for byte. |
| C-UNIT | 13 test files, 232 tests, all green, including TU12–TU15. |
| C-MUT | I ran two mutants on a scratch copy outside the repo. Dropping the new `settle` line turns TU12 and TU13 red. Restoring the old exact-match release turns only TU15 red. |
| C-REFUSAL (the round-237 bug) | First attempt valid at both viewports. The refusal stays on screen through the load finishing, then the release gives exactly the "Demo collection ready…" text. "Loading the demo collection…" never comes back. In round 237 it ended on the loading text. |
| C-REFUSAL-FAIL | When the hero file returns 404, the "1 sound … failed to load" text replaces the refusal while the fader is still held, and stays after the release. |
| C-REFUSAL-READY | Refusal after loading: the release restores the ready text exactly. I also tried Delete, Ctrl+D and Ctrl+Shift+Z during a held fader. Each was refused, no clip was added, and the status after the release matched the status before. |
| C-RACE | The delay, fail, idle and placement modes give the same exact texts as round 237. BPM 120 and Snap on appear where the pulse sets them. No line starts with a space. |
| C-L1 | Unit only, as the task defines it. I found no way to reach this case in the UI: pressing Enter on a library row while holding the fader seems to end the drag first. That is inferred from timing; I did not instrument the drag state. |
| C-SHOTS | New after-release screenshots sit next to the round-237 ones. The space check was not re-run because nothing permanent on screen changed. |
| AN-REVIEW | Line 4 of doc 185 is byte-exact, the headings are in order, and every cited test id exists. Docs 182/183 are unchanged. |
| C-REF | The task's "no reference found" is stated, and the three IDs are in `backlog.json`. |
| LAB-SMOKE | Space plays (non-silent) and pauses. The WAV export is 48 kHz, 24-bit, stereo, exactly 16.000 s, no NaN samples. Its hash is the same at both viewports and the same as in round 237. |
| Auth | `/studio-lab` opens with no account. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401 with no header and 500 with a fake token, so the premium check is not bypassed. |
| Purchased Studio in the browser | Blocked: the backend is not available in the cloud. Only unit tests cover it. |
| Full suite, verify, build, e2e smoke | Left for the root gate; not claimed. |

For B:
- **Test file differs from B's diff:** A added 6 lines that count status announcements in TU12 and TU14, following its code reviewer. They are inside grant 2 and remove nothing.
- **MU-L1-EFF not re-run:** the task didn't ask for it, so that result rests on A's report.
- **LRS4 timeout:** A's note on LRS4 (53 % of its 5 s timeout in one run) still needs B's ruling. It passed in my run.
- **Ableton:** no reference applies, because this is CZABA's own status-line rule.

With this PASS, the gate can publish rounds 237 and 238 together.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-238.md`
- `c-round-238.json`
- `c-round-238/` (scripts, logs, measurement JSON and screenshots)
